title: Apple just introduced a brand-new Apple Watch, the Apple Watch Series 4 (AAPL)
text:
Apple just introduced a brand-new Apple Watch, the Apple Watch Series 4 (AAPL) This entry was posted by admin on 09/13/2018 at 12:45
Apple has announced the Apple Watch Series 4, a new version of its best-selling smartwatch. The watch has new heart-tracking features, like the ability to take an electrocardiogram, and a larger, nearly edge-to-edge display. The Apple Watch Series 4 comes in silver, black, and gold, and starts at $399.
